lines.text: The agent broke the build again, for the third time today, and you are already typing.
You fire back a very direct message, with several words you would never say out loud.
Your thumb moves faster than your judgment, and you hit send before reading it back.
Agent R Q holds the message for a few seconds before the agent ever sees it.
Send Now and Cancel sit right there, on the message, for the whole countdown.
In that pause you read it again, and it looks much worse than it felt.
You tap Cancel. The message is pulled back, and the agent never knew it existed.
Then you write what actually helps. The failing test, the error, and the file you suspect.
This time you let the countdown run out, and the message lands exactly as written.
The agent reads a clear instruction and fixes the rounding bug on the first try.
Better instructions get better results, and a few seconds of pause is what gets you there.
What is the sharpest thing you have said to an agent? Admit it below, and try the send delay at Agent R Q dot com.
